Libraries for scRNA-seq were generated using the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5' Kit v2 (10× Genomics, Pleasanton, CA, USA) and Chromium Single Cell Human TCR Amplification Kit (10× Genomics) to read 5'-mRNA and full-length paired T-cell and B-cell receptor sequences following the manufacturer’s instructions
data_processing: Libraries were constructed and sequenced at a depth of approximately 50,000 reads per cell using the Novaseq 6000 platform (Illumina, San Diego, CA, USA).
The sequenced data were demultiplexed using the mkfastq function (Cell Ranger, 10X Genomics, v3.0.1) to generate fastq files.

We did not use HTO for demultiplexing. Instead, we performed demultiplexing using genotype information that was submitted. Demultiplexing can be done using tools like the demuxlet algorithm with the provided genotype information.
The feature-barcode matrices of RNA expression were analyzed using the Seurat R package (Seurat, v4.1.1)
Assembly: GRCH38
Supplementary files format and content: 10x Genomics output files: filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5, filtered_contig_annotations.csv

metadata.source_characteristics_json: ["tissue: PBMC", "cell type: mononuclear cell", "tissue: peripheral blood", "responsiveness: Long term responder", "cycle: C1D15", "patient: LPFS_1_8, LPFS_1_18, LPFS_1_20, LPFS_3_8"]
metadata.source_assignment_policy: Use deposited demuxlet BEST singlet calls only; exclude summary, doublets and ambiguous calls. Retain original labels, probabilities and likelihoods; confidence is uncalibrated. No new genotype inference or posterior threshold.
metadata.source_identity_policy: Each author donor suffix is matched within its exact GEO four-person pool and visit, backed by individual original gDNA records. Four explicit PD/PR legacy capture aliases are audited; no global identifier transform. Repeated patient codes across C1D1/C1D15 share donor identity.
metadata.source_phase_policy: Keep source C1D1/C1D15 visit labels; no exact dates or untreated status inferred. Genotyping records are donor provenance, not extra blood draws.
metadata.source_clinical_policy: Individual original responsiveness labels joined by canonical source patient record. Mixed-pool responsiveness is not assigned uniformly. No ages, sex, regimen or clinical values imputed from42-person trial aggregates.
metadata.source_QC_policy: Common project RNA gate500counts/200genes/20percentmitochondrial. Primary paper uses stricter mitochondrial/max-gene and additional doublet filters; this export does not claim to reproduce that final cell selection.
metadata.source_count_policy: Only original native integer RNA counts define library denominators and geometry. No integrated Seurat values, reference cell labels, TCR sequences or gDNA reads used.
metadata.split_assignment: unassigned; both visits of a study-scoped person stay together; cross-study identity unresolved
